sql_modules.mechanism: TypeORM DataSource transaction runner inside custom Unit of Work implementations.
atomicity_scope: Aggregate state updates (inserts/updates/deletes on domain tables)

safety_guarantees.rollback_on_failure: Any exception thrown within the transaction boundary causes TypeORM to execute a physical ROLLBACK. No partial writes are visible.
safety_guarantees.pre_commit_isolation: No EventBus dispatch or SQS publishing is allowed before the transaction commits.

nosql_modules.mechanism: AWS SDK v3 TransactWriteItemsCommand (DynamoDB physical transaction).
atomicity_scope: Inbox deduplication marker (INBOX# keys) on consumer side
Integration Outbox event record (OUTBOX# keys) on producer side

safety_guarantees.rollback_on_failure: If any condition expression (e.g. optimistic concurrency check or unique inbox key check) fails, DynamoDB cancels the entire transaction with TransactionCanceledException.
tests: test/faults/faults.spec.ts (Fault 18: inbox write rollback on conflict)

outbox_relay.mechanism: Lease-based scheduler with batch querying, exponential backoff, availableAt timestamps, and try limits.
outbox_relay.atomicity: Atomic write of status SUCCEEDED/FAILED inside DB, separated from actual async SNS publish (publish outside DB transaction).
tests: test/faults/faults.spec.ts (Fault 10: outbox RETRY transition on SNS error)
test/faults/faults.spec.ts (Fault 11: at-least-once retry on crash prior to status commit)

inbox_relay.mechanism: SQS Consumer with envelope Zod validation, unique DB inbox marker, and deferred SQS delete.
inbox_relay.atomicity: Inbox marker and business effect are saved in a single database transaction. SQS DeleteMessage is invoked ONLY after transaction commit.
tests: test/faults/faults.spec.ts (Fault 14: SQS redelivery on transaction failure)
test/faults/faults.spec.ts (Fault 15: post-commit consumer crash idempotency skip)
